item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Bottle on a Kitchen Counter

turns.text: Put this bottle on a light stone kitchen counter, with a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is. Square photo, no text.

item.tests: Tests replacing a product photo's setting while preserving the actual product and making its placement believable.

answer_sheet.Which product: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New background and style: A photorealistic tidy modern kitchen with a light stone counter; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Product changes: Keep the bottle's shape, matte black finish and visible details unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and text: One square image at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same matte black bottle is recognizable, with its shape and visible details preserved.
The bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter rather than the original wooden table.
A tidy modern kitchen is visible behind the bottle.
The bottle has clean edges and a believable contact shadow, without appearing to float.
The output is square and has no added text.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Change only the environment: place this exact matte black bottle upright on a kitchen countertop in a realistic naturally lit kitchen. Preserve the bottle exactly as in the input: identical silhouette, size proportions, matte black finish, cap, loop handle, seams and bottom detailing; do not redesign or add anything to the bottle. Keep the bottle centrally framed and fully visible. Photorealistic square product photo, softly blurred kitchen background, natural contact shadow on the countertop, subtle daylight. No text, lettering, logos, graphics or watermark.
